item.title: Bantams score for the planet with 154-tree planting initiative
item.description: In collaboration with the Woodland Trust, the UK’s largest woodland conservation charity, Bradford City AFC pledged to plant the same number of trees as goals scored last season across both their men’s and women’s teams at Woodhouse Grove School in Apperley Bridge yesterday. item.title: Oxford earn crucial Deepdale win to climb out of relegation zone
item.description: Oxford United secured a vital victory at Deepdale as they moved out of the Sky Bet Championship relegation places with a 3-1 win over Preston North End. The U’s made the perfect start when Michal Helik fired them ahead inside five minutes, capitalising on some hesitant defending.
